title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Cast and September 26 Streaming Premiere
content:
A Wild Last Boss Appeared has revealed its second Season 2 trailer, confirming that the anime will have a streaming premiere on September 26 a week ahead of its regular TV broadcast starting in October 2026. The sequel was announced immediately after the first season’s finale.

The anime previously revealed new cast and opening theme song “Melodic Impact” by Japanese rock band Suspended 4th. Today more additions were revealed:

• Akio Otsuka as Leon

• Atsushi Miyauchi as Sagittarius

• Shuhei Sakaguchi as Mercurius

The second trailer previews the ending theme “Yurete Skirt” by four-member girls rock band Chakura. Check it out below.

Including the director Yuya ‌Horiuchi, the main staff for the A Wild Last Boss Appeared anime consists of the following members:

• Director: Yuya Horiuchi

• Series Composition: Kazuyuki Fudeyasu

• Original Character Design: Yahako

• Character Design: Maiko Ebisawa

• Sub Character Design: Takashi Kobayashi, Shota Ueno

• Producer: WOWMAX

• Animation Studio: WAO World

Firehead writes the A Wild Last Boss Appeared (Yasei no Rasu Bosu ga Arawareta) light novel series, which features illustrations by YahaKo. It first began on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in October 2015, with Earth Star Entertainment publishing a print edition under their Earth Star Novel imprint from February 2016. Both ended on April 15, 2019. There is also a manga adaptation by Tsubasa Hazuki, which began serialization on Earth Star Entertainment’s Comic Earth Star website in June 2017 and is currently ongoing. J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga in English. The franchise has surpassed 1.7 million copies in circulation.

The story follows a man who wakes up in the body of his MMO character, Lufas Maphaahl, the feared Black-Winged Tyrant and leader of the Twelve Heavenly Stars, 200 years after her defeat in a player-driven event of the game Exgate Online . But this is no longer a game, but rather it’s reality. With her reign long past and her name remembered only in fear, Lufas now navigates a different world, looking for answers, allies, and a way to confront the chaos and monsters that her “death” left behind.
author: Anime Corner

title: Black Torch TV Anime Reveals 'Final' Promo Video
content:
The staff for the television anime of Tsuyoshi Takaki 's Black Torch manga revealed a "final" promotional video for the anime on Friday, previewing both the 11th and 12th episodes and the "final battle."

Kei Umabiki ( ClassicaLoid , Quality Assurance in Another World ) is directing the anime at 100Studio . Gō Suzuki ( Sword Art Online the Movie: Ordinal Scale , Minami-ke Tadaima ) is designing the characters, Gigaemon Ichikawa ( Chikasugi Idol Akae-chan , Himitsu no AiPri ) is supervising and writing the series scripts, and Yutaka Yamada ( Babylon , Tokyo Ghoul ) is composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Sub-Character Design: Yumi Nakamura, Masahiko Suzuki, Mariko Kinoshita

• Design Works: Shunya Kikuchi

• Art Director: Sachi Takahashi, Shōko Imaizumi

• Color Design: Haruko Nobori

• CG Director: Hirotaka Naito

• Director of Photography: Satoshi Yamamoto

• Editing: Masato Yoshitake

• Sound Director: Takeshi Takadera

• Sound Effects: Naoto Yamatani

SiM performs the opening theme song "Freeze Me Up," and I Don't Like Mondays. performs the ending theme song "Groooovy."

Viz Media publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

Jiro Azuma is descended from of a long line of shinobi, and he also can talk to animals. Although he may appear rough and tumble, his compassionate side emerges when it comes to furry critters. But Jiro's soft spot for animals gets him in major trouble when a suspicious stray cat fuses with him, granting him exceptional power but also dragging him into humanity's hidden battle against powerful, menacing spirits.

Takaki ( Heart Gear ) launched the manga series in Shueisha 's Jump Square magazine in December 2016. Shueisha shipped the fifth and final compiled book volume in August 2018.

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Anime's 2nd Part Reveals October 13 Debut in Promo Video
content:
Kadokawa revealed on Friday that the second cours (quarter of a year) of the television anime of Hiromu and raemz 's Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle ( Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka ) light novel series will debut on October 13. The staff also revealed the theme song information and a new promotional video.

The anime will debut on October 13 on AT-X at 11:00 p.m., before airing later that evening on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Sun TV , KBS Kyoto , Fukui Broadcasting, and TV Aichi . An "episode 13.5" that will recap the series thus far will air the week before.

Cider Girl performs the opening theme song "Saku" (To Bloom) and aruma performs the ending theme song "Doko nimo Ikenai Mama" (While I Can't Go Anywhere).

Yūji Tokuno ( Kiratto Pri☆Chan , Pretty Boy Detective Club ) is directing the series at feel. , and Naruhisa Arakawa ( Kingdom , Elemental Gelade ) is supervising the series scripts and co-writing them with original author Hiromu . Sumie Kinoshita ( Forest of Piano , Idoly Pride ) is designing the characters, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa is composing the music.

The staff describes the story:

Chitose Saku attends Fujishi High School, the best preparatory school in the prefecture. His studies, athletics and communication skills are all at a high level, and he attracts attention, for better or worse. He is the envy of everyone, and his friends are all very popular as well. In the spring of his second year, in a new class. Saku is asked to convince a withdrawn student to return to school. Set in Fukui prefecture, an emotional coming-of-age story begins!

Hiromu and raemz debuted the original light novel series in June 2019, and novel volume 9.5 shipped in October 2025. Yen Press is releasing the light novels and manga in North America. Manga UP! Global also publishes the manga in English digitally.

Bobcat launched the manga adaptation of the novels on Square Enix 's Manga UP! website in April 2020, and Square Enix published the manga's eighth and final compiled book volume in March 2025.
author: ANN

title: 'Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! 2nd Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Ending Theme, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Firehead 's Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! ( A Wild Last Boss Appeared! ) light novel unveiled additional cast, the ending theme, and second promotional video for the second season on Friday. The new season is scheduled to premiere on October 3 at 10:30 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS Asahi, and Kansai TV.

Cast Sagittarius: Atsushi Miyauchi ( Jidou Hanbaiki ni Umarekawatta Ore wa Meikyuu wo Samayou ) Leon: Akio Ootsuka ( Fate/Zero ) Mercurius: Shuuhei Sakaguchi ( Reincarnation no Kaben )

Girls band chakura is performing the ending theme "Yurete Skirt," which is previewed in the promotional video below.

Yuuya Horiuchi ( Nijiyon Animation ) is directing the anime at WAO World , with Kazuyuki Fudeyasu ( Black Clover ) handling the series composition. Maiko Ebisawa ( Undead Unluck animation director) is designing the characters. Technoboys Pulcraft Green-Fund ( Kakegurui ) is composing the music.

Produced by WAO World, the first season aired as a 12-episode series in Fall 2025. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with subtitles and later with dubs in multiple languages.

Firehead began penning the action fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2015. Earth Star Entertainment later acquired the series and began publishing the light novel in print under its Earth Star Novel imprint with illustrations by YahaKo in February 2016. The ninth and final volume was published in April 2019.

Tsubasa Hazuki began drawing a manga adaptation in Comic Earth☆Star in June 2017. Earth Star Entertainment shipped the 11th volume in November 2025.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga in English for digital release in April 2020 and January 2024, respectively. The light novel's ninth and final volume was released in July 2022, and the 11th manga volume went on sale on August 26.

title: BLACK TORCH Prepares For Final Episodes With New Trailer
content:
BLACK TORCH released a new “FINAL PV” trailer ahead of its concluding episodes, featuring footage from Episodes 11 and 12. The series first announced the anime adaptation back in March, surprising with its return following the manga’s cancellation in 2018. The anime is streaming on Crunchyroll.

You can watch the new trailer below.

The voice cast includes:

• Ryota Suzuki as Azuma Jiro

• Yoji Ueda as Rago

• Sayaka Senbongi as Ichika Kishimojin

• Junya Enoki as Reiji Kirihara

• Junichi Suwabe as Ryosuke Shiba

• Reina Ueda as Usami

The staff for the anime includes:

• Director: Kei Umabiki

• Character Design: Gou Suzuki

• Series Composition & Screenplay: Gigaemon Ichikawa

• Music: Yutaka Yamada

• Studio: One Double-0 studio

BLACK TORCH originally ran in Jump Square , a monthly magazine published by Shueisha, from February 2017 to April 2018. It later shifted to the Shonen Jump+ digital platform, where it continued until wrapping up in July 2018. The story has a total of 19 chapters, which were compiled into a total of five volumes. The English license was acquired by VIZ Media, with the first volume released on August 7, 2018.

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 2 Anime Reveals September 26 Early Streaming Debut, More Cast in 2nd Promo Video
content:
The official website for the television anime of Firehead and YahaKo 's A Wild Last Boss Appeared! light novel series revealed a second promotional video, more cast, September 26 early streaming debut, and ending theme song artist on Friday for the show's second season.

The above video reveals and previews Chakura's ending theme song "Yurete Skirt" (Swaying Skirt).

The new season will first debut on the ABEMA and U-NEXT streaming services on September 26 at 10:30 p.m., before airing on TV starting on October 3 at 10:30 p.m. on Tokyo MX . The series will air on BS Asahi and Kansai TV starting on October 4.

New cast members include:

Akio Ōtsuka as Leon

Atsushi Miyauchi as Sagittarius

Shūhei Sakaguchi as Melcrius

Previously announced new cast for the second season includes:

• Ryōta Suzuki as Karkinos

• Chiaki Takahashi as Scorpius

• Takahiro Sakurai as Castor

• Shinpachi Tsuji as Mizar

• Momoko Seto as Mass-Produced Libra

• Yūichirō Umehara as Terra

• M.A.O as Luna

Yūya Horiuchi returns to direct the second season at the studio Wao World , and Kazuyuki Fudeyasu is again in charge of the series scripts. The first season's character designer Maiko Ebisawa returns, but the first season's episode chief animation directors Tōko Nakamura , Takashi Kobayashi , Shōta Ueno , Mamiko Mizutani , and Takahiro Miura are also designing characters for the new season, along with new character designer Akiko Satō .

Additional returning staff members include:

• Color Key Artist: Tomoko Kohioki

• Art Director: Yukari Yasuda

• Compositing Director of Photography: Norimasa Teramoto

• Editing: Rina Koguchi

• Sound Director: Sōichirō Kubo

• Sound Production: Tohokushinsha Film Corporation

• Music: TECHNOBOYS PULCRAFT GREEN-FUND

Rock band Suspended 4th performs the opening theme song "Melodic Impact."

The staff describes the anime:

In the year 2800 of the Mizgard calendar, Rufus Mafarl — feared as the Black-Winged Conqueror — faces his final battle against the heroes known as the Seven Heroes. After an intense fight, his reign of domination comes to an end. Though peace seemed to have returned with his sealing, the balance of power collapses, leaving the world threatened by the devilfolk. 200 years later — in a desperate attempt to fight back, humanity summons a new hero. But instead, the overlord Lufas awakens from his long seal!But peace was short-lived, as the collapse of the power balance gave rise to a new threat—devilfolk.

The first season initially streamed on ABEMA and U-NEXT in September 2025, and then aired on Tokyo MX , BS Asahi , and Kansai TV in October 2025.

Firehead and YahaKo launched A Wild Last Boss Appeared! ( Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! ) story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Be Novelists) website in 2015, and the series ended in 2017. Earth Star Entertainment published the ninth and final light novel volume in print in April 2019. J-Novel Club released the novel series digitally in English.

Manga artist Tsubasa Hazuki launched a manga adaptation on the Comic Earth Star manga website in 2017. J-Novel Club is also publishing the manga in English. The book franchise has 1.4 million copies in circulation.

title: A Certain Item of Dark Side Anime Reveals Key Visual
content:
The upcoming A Certain ITEM of Dark Side anime has revealed a new key visual featuring the main characters ahead of the show’s October 9, 2026. The anime previously revealed all its members with a trailer . The main staff for the anime has several longtime A Certain franchise staff members, with Tatsuyuki Nagai returning as director, Shigeki Kimoto as character designer, Maiko Iuchi composing the music, and studio J.C. STAFF once again producing the animation.

The opening theme song “Ghost Sequence” by East Of Eden, which is the band’s first anime tie-in. The ending theme song is “Meltdowner” by Kishida Kyoudan & The Akeboshi Rockets, who previously performed the first ending theme for A Certain Scientific Railgun T . You can hear both songs in the previously revealed trailer.

Toaru Anbu no Shojo Kyosei (A Certain Dark Side’s Shared Life (ITEM)) is a spinoff set in the darker side of Academy City, focusing on the infamous underground organization ITEM. ITEM is one of Academy City’s dark side factions, consisting of high-level espers who take on covert and often deadly missions for the city’s ruling powers. While they operate as a team, their relationships quite complex. The team consists of:

• Shizuri Mugino (CV: Ami Koshimizu) – A Level 5 esper and the group’s leader, known for her powerful Meltdowner ability and explosive personality.

• Riko Takitsubo (CV: Aya Suzaki) – A Level 4 esper with AIM Stalker, an ability to track other espers, though at a big cost to her own health.

• Frenda Seivelun (CV: Maya Uchida) – A combat specialist who relies on traps and explosives rather than esper powers.

• Saiai Kinuhata (CV: Chinatsu Akasaki) – A Level 4 esper who manipulates nitrogen with Offense Armor, making her nearly invulnerable.

A Certain franchise originated from Kazuma Kamachi’s light novel A Certain Magical Index ( Toaru Majutsu no Index ), which first began in 2004 under Dengeki Bunko. The story is set in Academy City, a futuristic metropolis where scientific advancements allow for the development of esper abilities. It follows Toma Kamijo, an unlucky student with the mysterious power “Imagine Breaker,” as he gets mixed up into all sorts of trouble.

Following its popularity, the franchise got multiple anime adaptations and spin-offs, including:

• A Certain Magical Index (2008–2019) – The main series, following Toma’s battles against magical organizations and Academy City conspiracies.

• A Certain Scientific Railgun (2009–present) – A spin-off focusing on Mikoto Misaka, a Level 5 esper, and her battles to protect Academy City. Season 4 is currently in production.

• A Certain Scientific Accelerator (2019) – Another spin-off centered on Accelerator, Academy City’s strongest esper, as he struggles between his past sins and his newfound desire to protect others.

A Certain Scientific Accelerator (2019) – Another spin-off centered on Accelerator, Academy City’s strongest esper, as he struggles between his past sins and his newfound desire to protect others.

title: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 Reveals Collaboration Visual With From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman, Episode 1 Preview
content:
Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 has revealed a new collaboration visual with From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2, as well as the synopsis and preview for its first episode.

Episode 1 is titled “The Thing Floating in the Sky Was an Island.” As Teacher and Fran travel toward the port town of Dars, they discover a floating island along the way. The pair are attacked by a skeletal knight and crash onto the island, where they encounter a necromancer named Jean. Shinichiro Miki as Teacher and Ai Kakuma as Fran narrate the preview trailer for the episode, which you can watch below.

The new collaboration visual brings together Reincarnated as a Sword and From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman through their shared focus on swords and mentorship. Fran is guided by Teacher, while Beryl guides his own students. From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2 is currently airing , streaming on Prime Video.

To commemorate the crossover, both anime are holding a campaign through their official X accounts, with postcards featuring the collaboration visual being offered as prizes.

Yu Tanaka writes the original Reincarnated as a Sword light novel. The novel started off on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in October 2015 with illustrations by LLO. GC Novels started publishing it in the light novel format in 2016. A manga adaptation by Tomowo Maruyama is ongoing as well, and there is also a spin-off manga Reincarnated as a Sword: Another Wish by Hinako Inoue, which began in June 2020. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the light novel , the manga , and the spin-off manga .

Shigeru Sagazaki writes the From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman: My Hotshot Disciples Are All Grown Up Now and They Won’t Leave Me Alone ( Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru: Tada no Inaka no Kenjutsu Shihan Datta noni, Taisei Shita Deshitachi ga Ore o Hottekurenai Ken ) light novel series, which features illustrations by Tetsuhiro Nabeshima.

The story originally debuted in November 2020 on the user-generated Shosetsuka ni Naro website. It later caught the attention of Square Enix, who picked it up in April 2021 and began publishing it through their SQEX Novel label. A manga version illustrated by Kazuki Sato has been running in AKITASHOTEN’s Dokodemo Young Champion since August 2021. The light novel has been licensed in English by J-Novel Club, while the manga adaptation is being released by Yen Press.

title: 'Psyren' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, Main Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga revealed additional cast, staff, opening theme, key visual (pictured), and the main promotional video on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on October 5 at 11.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11 and Sun TV.

Voice actors Yuuko Kaida ( Spy x Family ) and Nobuyuki Hiyama ( Gachiakuta ) are joining the cast as Matsuri Yakumo and Dolki, respectively.

Staff Creature Design: Yoshitaka Taniguchi ( Sentai Red Isekai de Boukensha ni Naru mechanical design) Art Director: Kenichi Tajiri ( Turkey! ) Color Design: Yoshimi Kawakami ( Farmagia ) Director of Photography: Haruka Gotou ( Puniru wa Kawaii Slime ), Kiho Sakai Editing: Ryouko Kaneshige ( Helck ) Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka )

Musical band CLAN QUEEN is performing the opening theme "WARNING!!," which is previewed in the main promotional video below.

Katsumi Ono ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu ) is directing the anime at Satelight . Shin Yoshida ( Sacred Seven ) is handling the series composition. Shiro Ookuma ( Seishun Buta Yarou wa Santa Claus no Yume o Minai animation director) is designing the characters, while Takashi Oomama ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( Ore wa Subete wo "Parry" suru ), and Shuu Kanematsu ( Hametsu no Oukoku ) are composing the music.

Iwashiro drew the sci-fi action manga in Weekly Shounen Jump from December 2007 to November 2010. Shueisha published the 16th and final volume in March 2011.

SOW penned a side story light novel with illustrations by Iwashiro under Shueisha's Jump J Books imprint from September 2010 to March 2011.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in April 2010 and published the 16th and final volume in May 2014.

title: PSYREN Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Theme Song, Voice Cast
content:
The upcoming PSYREN anime revealed a new trailer, key visual, and cast ahead of the show’s October 5, 2026 premiere. It was also previously confirmed that it will be a complete adaptation , covering the entirety of the story. The anime will stream on Crunchyroll worldwide excluding Japan and Russia (IVI will stream it in Russia).

The main voice cast includes Rikuya Yasuda as protagonist Ageha Yoshina and Mayuko Kazama as Sakurako Amamiya. They are supported by Shunsuke Takeuchi as Hiryu Asaga, Soma Saito as Oboro Mochizuki, and Yukihiro Nozuyama as Kabuto Kirisaki. Today, two additional members were announced:

• Yuhko Kaida as Matsuri Yagumo, Sakurako Amamiya’s mentor

• Nobuyuki Hiyama as Dolkey, an enemy who stands in the way of Ageha and the others

The voice actors commented on their roles:

I’m Yuhko Kaida, the voice of Matsuri Yagumo. Just watching the trailer is enough to get me incredibly excited! Recording has been an absolute blast, working alongside such an amazing staff and talented cast. Matsuri may love her drinks, but she’s also a dependable, big-sister type, and I’m having a fantastic time giving the role everything I’ve got. After nearly 15 years, Ageha and the others’ game is finally set in motion. Let’s uncover the mysteries of the world of PSYREN together!

PSYREN was originally serialized quite some time ago, and now, after all these years, it’s finally getting an anime adaptation. You can really feel the power this series has! Dolkey, the character I play, is—in a way—a pretty straightforward villain!! I absolutely love playing characters like him, so I was able to really throw myself into his direct confrontations with the protagonists. I hope you’ll enjoy seeing that side of him in action!!

The opening theme is “WARNING!!” by three-member unit CLAN QUEEN!, and you can hear a preview in the new trailer below.

The main staff for the anime includes:

• Original Work by Toshiaki Iwashiro (Published by Shueisha)

• Directed by Katsumi Ono

• Series Composition by Shin Yoshida

• Character Design by Akira Okuma

• Music by Takashi Ohmama, Tatsuhiko Saiki, Shu Kanematsu

• Animation Production by SATELIGHT

AOi from CLAN QUEEN commented:

I had the honor of writing “WARNING!!,” the opening theme for PSYREN. I’m incredibly grateful for the opportunity to be involved through music in this long-awaited anime adaptation. I wrote the song with the image of pushing beyond your limits and continuing to reach out, even as warning alarms ring throughout your entire body. Above all, this is a track where every sound bursts forth with raw energy. Devour our creativity.

The series is described as follows:

One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psyren.” When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

You can also read a strong case for why this manga has long been deserving of an anime adaptation .
